title: The Map I Made Myself
transcript: When I moved to a different part of the city, I relied on my phone to find every address. After several weeks, I still could not tell which streets connected to each other. One Sunday, I left my phone in my bag and drew a rough map as I walked. I marked the corner shop, the park entrance and the bridge. The map was not very accurate, but making it helped me remember the route. Now I can walk to the station without checking a screen.

questions.prompt: What difficulty remained after several weeks?
options: The speaker often missed the train.
The speaker had no phone signal at home.
The speaker could not find the city centre.
The speaker could not tell how streets connected.
questions.answer: The speaker could not tell how streets connected.
questions.explanation: 仍然不清楚街道之间如何相连。

questions.prompt: What was the benefit of making the map?
options: The map could be sold to visitors.
The route became easier to remember.
The speaker found a shorter train line.
The speaker learnt to repair a phone.
questions.answer: The route became easier to remember.
questions.explanation: 虽然草图并不十分精确，绘制过程却帮助记住了路线。
